name: Webcam Preview (macOS)
summary: Open your Mac's built-in or USB webcam and show it in a preview window. macOS only.
description: Uses AVFoundation (the native macOS capture API) to open the camera. Set `deviceIndex` to pick which camera if you have multiple (0 = first listed). Includes the standard color-space conversion needed before macOS can display the video. macOS will prompt for camera permission the first time you run it.
